# Discussion title

- **Opened:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status:** open
- **Question:** one material choice that is not yet settled

## Context

Why the choice matters and what work it can block.

## Strongest case

The best evidence for the leading option.

## Counter-case

The strongest failure mode or objection.

## Alternatives

Materially different or smaller options.

## Falsifiers and evidence needed

What observation would overturn the leading case or let the owner conclude the
discussion.

## Conclusion

`Pending`. When concluded, record the verdict without erasing rejected
arguments; when applied, link the decision and exact roadmap/contract changes.
